conflicts.remarks_quote: Some SolidWorks properties and methods, such as this method, have an input object that must be marshaled to an IDispatch object array because System.Object has replaced VARIANT in the .NET framework. When marshaling System.Object to an IDispatch object array, you must explicitly control the marshaling behavior by using the **System.Runtime.InteropServices.DispatchWrapper** class.
